# Smarter Crowdsourcing: Coronavirus

> Smarter Crowdsourcing in the Age of Coronavirus, a 2020 project of The GovLab in collaboration with the Inter-American Development Bank, brought together experts to devise solutions to public health challenges of the COVID-19 pandemic across mitigation, preparedness, response and recovery. This site publishes its recommendations for governments on six topics (testing strategy, contact tracing, behavioral science, supporting marginalized populations, monitoring, mental health), each with strategies, actions and examples from around the world. Text licensed CC BY-SA 4.0.

## Pages

- [Smarter Crowdsourcing in the Age of Coronavirus](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/index.md): How do we design and source tests? How do we determine whom to test? What is the best strategy to administer tests and collect data?
- [About Smarter Crowdsourcing in the Age of Coronavirus](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/about.md): Complex and interdependent problems, like coronavirus, demand access to expertise that is widely dispersed. Global and complex public health emergencies threaten public health and well-being, risk disruption to global and regional trade and economic stability, and cause widespread uncertainty and concern. This project will focus on devising innovative solutions to public health challenges across all four stages of crisis response, including mitigation, preparedness, response and recovery.

- [Recommendations](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/recommendations.md): Recommendations for governments to strengthen government capacity for COVID testing strategies, contact tracing programs, public health communications, vulnerable population supports, monitoring systems, and mental health interventions
- [Strategies](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/strategies.md): Strategies for implementing recommendations proposed by experts through Smarter Crowdsourcing conferences
- [Executive Memos](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/executive-memos.md): Complex and interdependent problems, like coronavirus, demand access to expertise that is widely dispersed. Global and complex public health emergencies threaten public health and well-being, risk disruption to global and regional trade and economic stability, and cause widespread uncertainty and…

Global and complex public health emergencies threaten public health and well-being, risk disruption to global and regional trade and economic stability, and cause widespread uncertainty and…
- [Testing Strategy](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/testing-strategy.md): How do we design and source tests? How do we determine whom to test? What is the best strategy to administer tests and collect data?
- [Contact Tracing](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/contact-tracing.md): What are the challenges associated with locating people with whom an infected person has come into contact?
- [Behavioral Science and COVID](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/behavioral-science.md): How can governments use behavioral science to support the fight against COVID-19?
- [Supporting Marginalized and Vulnerable Populations](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/supporting-marginalized-populations.md): What are the best strategies to address disparities caused or exacerbated by the pandemic?
- [Epidemiological monitoring and surveillance](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/monitoring.md): How can governments support a sustained recovery by developing and improving epidemiological monitoring and surveillance strategies for the “new normal?
- [Mental health and emotional wellbeing](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/mental-health.md): What innovative and cost effective solutions can governments and communities implement to support the mental health needs of specific and general populations caused or exacerbated by the pandemic?
- [Pooled Testing](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/recommendations/pooled-testing.md): Governments and researchers should implement pooled testing strategies, innovating with pool design through ranking schemes or geographic schemes.
- [National Patient Identifiers](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/recommendations/national-patient-identifiers.md): Governments should take steps toward developing a unique health identifier/national patient identifier system (UHI/NPI) that unambiguously identifies each individual and links her to her health records, including test results.
- [High-risk populations](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/recommendations/high-risk-populations.md): Governments should prioritize conducting tests among populations with a high probability of 1) contracting the virus; 2), spreading it to others; and 3) suffering serious consequences as a result of infection.
- [Metrics](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/recommendations/metrics.md): Governments should establish and use metrics to (1) indicate thresholds where contact tracing is more or less effective as a containment and mitigation strategy; and (2) track progress and effectiveness of ongoing contact tracing programs.
- [Interjurisdictional Coordination](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/recommendations/interjurisdictional-coordination.md): Governments should increase vertical and horizontal interjurisdictional coordination by (1) incentivizing the use of interoperable or the same contact tracing platform and data collection process and (2) creating opportunities for knowledge sharing.
- [Localization](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/recommendations/localization.md): Governments should increase public trust in contact tracing programs by ensuring the programs incorporate local knowledge and experience. Specifically, they should (1) conduct an assessment that identifies community assets; (2) partner with local community organizations to identify contact tracers; (3) conduct a public health messaging campaign to explain contact tracing; and (4) incorporate information about the local community when training the contact tracing workforce.
- [Improve Data Management](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/recommendations/improve-data-management.md): Improve data management (collection, storage, and analysis) processes to support evidence-driven programs and policies that identify vulnerable populations and account for their needs.
- [Establish Public-Private Partnerships](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/recommendations/establish-public-private-partnerships.md): Establish Public-Private Partnerships that support vulnerable populations by filling service delivery gaps that community-based organizations, governments, and NGOs struggle to execute efficiently working on their own, while also benefiting the private institutions by providing them with financing and other resources.
- [Engage the Public and Civil Society Organizations](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/recommendations/engage-the-public-and-civil-society-organizations.md): Engage the public and civil society organizations to support vulnerable populations by capitalizing on existing knowledge and expertise, leveraging local assets and resources, building trust with intended beneficiaries, and strengthening the capacity of communities.
- [Enhance Data Collection](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/recommendations/enhance-data-collection.md): Enhance data collection capabilities through innovations in technologies, crowdsourcing, symptom-trackers, and partnerships.
- [Improve Information Infrastructure](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/recommendations/improve-information-infrastructure.md): Improve public health monitoring and surveillance information infrastructure by standardizing data formats and definitions, sharing data, and developing regulations and legislation that support public health monitoring and surveillance.
- [Increase Government Capacity](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/recommendations/increase-government-capacity.md): Increase government capacity to use public health monitoring and surveillance information to make policy and programmatic decisions.
- [Government capacity and regulatory environment](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/recommendations/government-capacity-and-regulatory-environment.md): Improve legislative and regulatory frameworks for mental health services.
- [Data and Technology](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/recommendations/data-and-technology.md): Use digital technologies and data to and expand access to mental health services and improve service delivery.
- [Increase provider capacity](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/recommendations/increase-provider-capacity.md): Increase provider capacity through innovations in training opportunities and strategies to expand the workforce supply.
- [Evidence and misinformation](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/recommendations/evidence-and-misinformation.md): Combat misinformation through evidence-based, clear, and consistent messaging.
- [Community and stakeholder engagement](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/recommendations/community-and-stakeholder-engagement.md): Engage communities and other stakeholders to make messaging strategies context specific and culturally relevant.
- [Data and innovation](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/recommendations/data-and-innovation.md): Use data and innovations like crowdsourcing to optimize messaging development, reach, and uptake.
- [Partner with academic institutions,researchers and private sector laboratories.](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/strategies/Partner-with-academic-institutions,researchers-and.md): Partner with academic institutions,researchers and private sector laboratories. Governments should engage the academy,research firms,and private sector laboratories to develop algorithms,testing strategies,and innovative ways to design pooled testing schemes.
- [Waive regulatory barriers.](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/strategies/Waive-regulatory-barriers.-Governments-should-cons.md): Waive regulatory barriers. Governments should consider ways to adjust regulations that restrict innovation pertaining to pooled testing schemes.
- [Rapidly pilot pooled testing schemes.](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/strategies/Rapidly-pilot-pooled-testing-schemes.-Governments-.md): Rapidly pilot pooled testing schemes. Governments should act quickly ( different contexts and populations .
- [Iterate learning and share best practices.](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/strategies/Iterate-learning-and-share-best-practices.-Governm.md): Iterate learning and share best practices. Governments should contract with or perform their own evaluation of pooled testing schemes,improve on existing processes,and share best practices across jurisdictions and sectors.
- [Conduct feasibility studies.](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/strategies/Conduct-feasibility-studies.-Governments-should-ap.md): Conduct feasibility studies. Governments should appoint a group of government and external experts to conduct a feasibility study of jurisdictional and private/public context and document legislative opportunities or barriers to moving forward with a UHI/NPI system.
- [Standardize data entry fields across existing systems.](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/strategies/Standardize-data-entry-fields-across-existing-syst.md): Standardize data entry fields across existing systems. Governments should work with partners to standardize data elements across health IT systems so that data is easily shareable between systems.
- [Develop,advocate for and pass legislation.](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/strategies/Develop,advocate-for-and-pass-legislation.-Governm.md): Develop,advocate for and pass legislation. Governments should mandate adoption of standards providing for a standard national health identifier for each individual,employer,health plan,and health care provider for use in the healthcare system.
- [Adjust existing data collection processes.](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/strategies/Adjust-existing-data-collection-processes.-Governm.md): Adjust existing data collection processes. Governments should advance the use of regularly collected demographic data elements for patient matching and identification such as phone numbers,mailing addresses,or email addresses. This will ensure that public health authorities have up-to-date contact information when receiving reports from laboratories,hospitals,and other testing sites.
- [Establish a single organization to manage and oversee the UHI/NPI system.](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/strategies/Establish-a-single-organization-to-manage-and-over.md): Establish a single organization to manage and oversee the UHI/NPI system. Governments should establish a single organization with the responsibility to oversee and advise on ways to improve patient matching and incorporate new technologies and approaches as they emerge. This organization would identify and encourage adoption of certain standards—such as on biometrics or use of smartphones—by health care organizations and technology developers.
- [Implement a UHI/NPI system.](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/strategies/Implement-a-UHI/NPI-system.-Governments-should-rol.md): Implement a UHI/NPI system. Governments should roll out a comprehensive and single UHI/NPI system that integrates,delivers,and manages health information technology systems across all health care institutions,including the ability for individuals to access and control their own health records.
- [Define high-risk populations who will receive prioritized testing.](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/strategies/Define-high-risk-populations-who-will-receive-prio.md): Define high-risk populations who will receive prioritized testing. Governments should develop a working definition of which populations are high risk. Groups can be added to this list,but the list should identify populations that are at higher risk of contracting and having complications from COVID-19 due to physical health,behavioral health,or economic/social factors.
- [Partner with community and cultural leaders.](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/strategies/Partner-with-community-and-cultural-leaders.-Gover.md): Partner with community and cultural leaders. Governments should conduct specific outreach and form partnerships with community and cultural leaders to 1) understand needs and concerns of specific communities and 2) amplify public health messaging encouraging surveillance,diagnostic,and screening testing.
- [Make testing free for low income or high-risk populations.](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/strategies/Make-testing-free-for-low-income-or-high-risk-popu.md): Make testing free for low income or high-risk populations. Governments should reduce barriers to testing by making testing free for specific populations,ideally for screening or surveillance purposes.
- [Develop and use culturally and contextually relevant communication materials for testing resources.](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/strategies/Develop-and-use-culturally-and-contextually-releva.md): Develop and use culturally and contextually relevant communication materials for testing resources. Governments and public health officials should make all communication materials targeted at high-risk or vulnerable populations accessible and culturally-relevant.
- [Rapidly conduct snapshot pooled testing among staff and residents in health and long-term care…](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/strategies/Rapidly-conduct-snapshot-pooled-testing-among-staf.md): Rapidly conduct snapshot pooled testing among staff and residents in health and long-term care facilities,prisons,and other congregate housing facilities. Governments should conduct snapshot pooled testing to provide a baseline that will help establish subsequent testing strategies within these settings,including the frequency of testing.
- [Ensure adequate testing resources are available and accessible to high-risk communities.](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/strategies/Ensure-adequate-testing-resources-are-available-an.md): Ensure adequate testing resources are available and accessible to high-risk communities. Governments should establish testing sites in communities with large numbers of high-risk individuals.
- [Reduce barriers to testing by conducting mobile testing units.](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/strategies/Reduce-barriers-to-testing-by-conducting-mobile-te.md): Reduce barriers to testing by conducting mobile testing units. To address transportation limitations,non-traditional work schedules,and lack of access that may keep some communities from getting tested,governments should strategically implement mobile testing units that travel to vulnerable communities.
- [Make raw data available to researchers,public health professionals and epidemiologists.](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/strategies/Make-raw-data-available-to-researchers,public-heal.md): Make raw data available to researchers,public health professionals and epidemiologists. Governments should make disaggregated and,where appropriate,raw data available for modeling and epidemiological analysis. Sharing key process and outcome data with demographic and geographic identifiers allows researchers and public health officials to better predict and respond to the spread of the virus and emerging outbreaks.
- [Incentivize adoption of standardized process and outcome measures within jurisdictions (vertical…](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/strategies/Incentivize-adoption-of-standardized-process-and-o.md): Incentivize adoption of standardized process and outcome measures within jurisdictions (vertical standardization) and across jurisdictions (horizontal standardization) through technical assistance and cost reimbursements or cost sharing. Governments should use legislative,regulatory,and budgetary means to incentivize and/or mandate the adoption of standardized metrics across jurisdictions.
- [Create and publish data dashboards that are updated regularly and show progress on metrics.](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/strategies/Create-and-publish-data-dashboards-that-are-update.md): Create and publish data dashboards that are updated regularly and show progress on metrics. Governments should develop a dashboard aligned with both the contact tracing platform and surveillance/reportable disease databases.
- [Commit to carefully selected metrics that can be reported on consistently and regularly (do not select too…](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/strategies/Commit-to-carefully-selected-metrics-that-can-be-r.md): Commit to carefully selected metrics that can be reported on consistently and regularly (do not select too many metrics). Governments should be cautious to select a small number of useful and informative metrics that can be reported on consistently,precisely,and accurately. Committing to too many metrics may lead to the inability to accurately and precisely track the data.
- [Collaborate with private and public-sector actors that have large membership across jurisdictions.](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/strategies/Collaborate-with-private-and-public-sector-actors-.md): Collaborate with private and public-sector actors that have large membership across jurisdictions. Governments should actively seek partnerships with businesses and organizations (e.g. unions) that have large numbers of employees or members based in various regions/states within the country. These businesses and organizations may be able to support interjurisdictional coordination.
- [Use executive orders or other regulatory or legislative authorities to incentivize centralized platforms for…](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/strategies/Use-executive-orders-or-other-regulatory-or-legisl.md): Use executive orders or other regulatory or legislative authorities to incentivize centralized platforms for contact tracing. Governments,ideally at the federal level,should mandate a single platform for contact tracing. If it is not possible at the federal level,governors of states/regions should mandate the use of a single platform within their jurisdiction.
- [Use legislative or regulatory mechanisms or executive orders to enable data sharing across jurisdictions.](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/strategies/Use-legislative-or-regulatory-mechanisms-or-execut.md): Use legislative or regulatory mechanisms or executive orders to enable data sharing across jurisdictions. Governments should reduce the regulatory burdens that hinder or inhibit data sharing between jurisdictions.
- [Move towards a centralized communicable and reportable disease database and contact tracing capability.](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/strategies/Move-towards-a-centralized-communicable-and-report.md): Move towards a centralized communicable and reportable disease database and contact tracing capability. Governments should begin to invest in a federally centralized communicable and reportable disease database that will include contact tracing capabilities.
- [Offer informal peer learning opportunities.](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/strategies/Offer-informal-peer-learning-opportunities.-Govern.md): Offer informal peer learning opportunities. Governments or representative associations should coordinate informal forums or opportunities for individuals designing,implementing,and managing contact tracing programs to share ideas,challenges and best practices. These opportunities should be extended to include researchers,epidemiologists,or non-governmental actors with contact tracking experience.
- [Offer formal peer learning opportunities. governments or representative associations should coordinate…](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/strategies/Offer-formal-peer-learning-opportunities.-governme.md): Offer formal peer learning opportunities. governments or representative associations should coordinate formal and structured forums or opportunities for those designing,implementing,and managing contact tracing programs to share ideas,challenges and best practices.
- [Create regional partnerships and coordinating bodies.](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/strategies/Create-regional-partnerships-and-coordinating-bodi.md): Create regional partnerships and coordinating bodies. Governments or representative associations should establish formal and informal groups and coordinating bodies based on regional or geographic similarities,such as transportation corridors or shared geographic borders.
- [Conduct a community health assessment that identifies community assets.](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/strategies/Conduct-a-community-health-assessment-that-identif.md): Conduct a community health assessment that identifies community assets. Public health agencies responsible for conducting contact tracing should conduct an assessment of community organizations and assets that can be mobilized to support the contact tracing effort.
- [Partner with local community organizations to recruit and hire contact tracers with community-based…](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/strategies/Partner-with-local-community-organizations-to-recr.md): Partner with local community organizations to recruit and hire contact tracers with community-based knowledge and experience. Governments should partner with local community organizations to identify contact tracers with the trust and knowledge of the local community. Selecting the right messenger is an important step to building trust,allowing for the cases and contacts to reveal details about who they have been in contact with and when.
- [Conduct a public health messaging campaign explaining contact tracing.](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/strategies/Conduct-a-public-health-messaging-campaign-explain.md): Conduct a public health messaging campaign explaining contact tracing. Governments should perform outreach to the public with messages about contact tracing before and while they implement telephone and in-person interviews and contact tracing. This will help the public understand why they are being contacted and what the goal of these efforts are.
- [Incorporate communication about contact tracing into the testing program.](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/strategies/Incorporate-communication-about-contact-tracing-in.md): Incorporate communication about contact tracing into the testing program. Testing centers should inform those who are tested that they will be contacted by someone from the contact tracing program if they test positive. The testing site should provide the name of the contact tracing program and the phone number from which people will receive a call.
- [Incorporate information about the local community when training people for the contact tracing program.](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/strategies/Incorporate-information-about-the-local-community-.md): Incorporate information about the local community when training people for the contact tracing program. Governments and those designing contact tracing training programs should include specific modules that focus on the local community context,cultural practices,language considerations,and other specific considerations. The training program should also include information about how to conduct contact tracing,the workforce needs information about the local public health system,how it is organized and how it interacts with other agencies.
- [Review data collection processes and ensure all data systems adequately collect disaggregated data…](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/strategies/Review-data-collection-processes-and-ensure-all-da.md): Review data collection processes and ensure all data systems adequately collect disaggregated data differentiating vulnerable populations.
- [Build coalitions with “trust brokers” (e.g. NGOs,Civil Society Organizations,and community leaders) and…](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/strategies/Build-coalitions-with-%E2%80%9Ctrust-brokers%E2%80%9D-(e.g.-NG.md): Build coalitions with “trust brokers” (e.g. NGOs,Civil Society Organizations,and community leaders) and affected populations to co-design data collection,analysis and use processes
- [Collect disaggregated data at strategic locations and service delivery touchpoints.](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/strategies/Collect-disaggregated-data-at-strategic-locations-.md): Collect disaggregated data at strategic locations and service delivery touchpoints.
- [Strengthen government capacity to interpret new and existing data,focusing on vulnerable populations and…](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/strategies/Strengthen-government-capacity-to-interpret-new-an.md): Strengthen government capacity to interpret new and existing data,focusing on vulnerable populations and publish data and analysis publicly.
- [Establish and coordinate a committee of stakeholders whose businesses,non-profits,and foundations directly…](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/strategies/Establish-and-coordinate-a-committee-of-stakeholde.md): Establish and coordinate a committee of stakeholders whose businesses,non-profits,and foundations directly serve or impact vulnerable populations to identify and address the needs of vulnerable populations.
- [Develop partnerships and engage in strategic contracts with companies who have comparative advantages or…](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/strategies/Develop-partnerships-and-engage-in-strategic-contr.md): Develop partnerships and engage in strategic contracts with companies who have comparative advantages or corners on specific markets like housing,transportation,diagnostic testing,and/or technology services.
- [Create a public commission,specifically including intended beneficiaries of the services,tasked with holding…](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/strategies/Create-a-public-commission,specifically-including-.md): Create a public commission,specifically including intended beneficiaries of the services,tasked with holding public-private partnership contracts accountable for delivering services/results through a cost effective,timely,and transparent process.
- [Partner with private sector firms to help them meet their human resource needs by developing and…](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/strategies/Partner-with-private-sector-firms-to-help-them-mee.md): Partner with private sector firms to help them meet their human resource needs by developing and implementing retraining and reskillIng programs that help vulnerable groups adapt to the new- normal post- COVID- 19.
- [Work with local community leaders to tailor policy decisions to the needs of the community.](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/strategies/Work-with-local-community-leaders-to-tailor-policy.md): Work with local community leaders to tailor policy decisions to the needs of the community.
- [Partner with,fund,and support women and their families,women-owned businesses,and grassroots organizations…](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/strategies/Partner-with,fund,and-support-women-and-their-fami.md): Partner with,fund,and support women and their families,women-owned businesses,and grassroots organizations specifically serving women.
- [Detect,support and amplify existing community-led initiatives and solutions.](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/strategies/Detect,support-and-amplify-existing-community-led-.md): Detect,support and amplify existing community-led initiatives and solutions.
- [Crowdsource solutions and expertise from the public and affected populations through prizes,competitions,or…](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/strategies/Crowdsource-solutions-and-expertise-from-the-publi.md): Crowdsource solutions and expertise from the public and affected populations through prizes,competitions,or online innovation sessions.
- [Collect epidemiological surveillance data with a symptom tracker or triage tool that leverages crowdsourcing…](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/strategies/Collect-epidemiological-surveillance-data-with-a-s.md): Collect epidemiological surveillance data with a symptom tracker or triage tool that leverages crowdsourcing and participatory surveillance.
- [Invest in and promote the use of technological and digital innovations that can help collect accurate and…](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/strategies/Invest-in-and-promote-the-use-of-technological-and.md): Invest in and promote the use of technological and digital innovations that can help collect accurate and timely data.
- [Partner with institutions with high levels of social engagement,trust,and access to populations to collect…](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/strategies/Partner-with-institutions-with-high-levels-of-soci.md): Partner with institutions with high levels of social engagement,trust,and access to populations to collect information and implement public health monitoring and surveillance systems.
- [Develop standard definitions,structures,and variables for key public health monitoring and surveillance…](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/strategies/Develop-standard-definitions,structures,and-variab.md): Develop standard definitions,structures,and variables for key public health monitoring and surveillance health data.
- [Promote and use open source and simple tools for data sharing between and among stakeholders.](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/strategies/Promote-and-use-open-source-and-simple-tools-for-d.md): Promote and use open source and simple tools for data sharing between and among stakeholders.
- [Develop and advocate for a legislative framework for public health monitoring and surveillance health data.](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/strategies/Develop-and-advocate-for-a-legislative-framework-f.md): Develop and advocate for a legislative framework for public health monitoring and surveillance health data.
- [Increase government capacity to use public health monitoring and surveillance data by training government…](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/strategies/Increase-government-capacity-to-use-public-health-.md): Increase government capacity to use public health monitoring and surveillance data by training government workers in data science and partnering with data scientists.
- [Develop,use,and refine multiple predictive models to help with pandemic planning,preparedness,and response.](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/strategies/Develop,use,and-refine-multiple-predictive-models-.md): Develop,use,and refine multiple predictive models to help with pandemic planning,preparedness,and response.
- [Create a COVID-19 “war room”,emergency operation center,or nerve center that centralizes data and decision…](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/strategies/Create-a-COVID-19-%E2%80%9Cwar-room%E2%80%9D,emergency-operati.md): Create a COVID-19 “war room”,emergency operation center,or nerve center that centralizes data and decision making.
- [Create a legal framework to regulate and fund mental health priorities](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/strategies/Create-a-legal-framework-to-regulate-and-fund-ment.md): Create a legal framework to regulate and fund mental health priorities
- [Create a national mental health plan to guide the implementation of the resulting legislation and regulations](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/strategies/Create-a-national-mental-health-plan-to-guide-the-.md): Create a national mental health plan to guide the implementation of the resulting legislation and regulations
- [Promote public policies and interventions that prioritize mental health services for healthcare workers and…](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/strategies/Promote-public-policies-and-interventions-that-pri.md): Promote public policies and interventions that prioritize mental health services for healthcare workers and frontline personnel
- [Use technology to bridge access gaps and reach individuals who cannot access treatment due to…](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/strategies/Use-technology-to-bridge-access-gaps-and-reach-ind.md): Use technology to bridge access gaps and reach individuals who cannot access treatment due to cost,location,language,or other barriers.
- [Improve mental health data collection and use through technologies](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/strategies/Improve-mental-health-data-collection-and-use-thro.md): Improve mental health data collection and use through technologies
- [Use technology to train community health workers and other healthcare providers who may have no experience…](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/strategies/Use-technology-to-train-community-health-workers-a.md): Use technology to train community health workers and other healthcare providers who may have no experience in mental healthcare and mental first aid
- [Engage cross-sectoral partners to utilize available mental health resources and increase the supply of…](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/strategies/Engage-cross-sectoral-partners-to-utilize-availabl.md): Engage cross-sectoral partners to utilize available mental health resources and increase the supply of providers

The public is more likely to trust messages coming from credible sources

Where possible,messaging should be targeted to specific populations and groups to ensure it is relevant and resonates with those individuals.

Who is an influencer in a given community can be determined using sentiment analysis techniques that analyze who follows whom on Twitter.

- [Governments should understand the preferences of their constituencies and use tools that populations are…](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/strategies/Governments-should-understand-the-preferences-of-t.md): Governments should understand the preferences of their constituencies and use tools that populations are most comfortable with. For example,live streams on social media platforms like facebook- which people use regularly and have fewer barriers to access-- tend to be more popular then webinars or conversations on platforms like Zoom or WebEx.

- [Governments should analyze what physical barriers make it more difficult or increase the perceived effort of…](https://coronavirus.smartercrowdsourcing.org/strategies/Governments-should-analyze-what-physical-barriers-.md): Governments should analyze what physical barriers make it more difficult or increase the perceived effort of following preferred behaviors,and minimize or remove these barriers. The fewer steps and the less thought a preferred behavior requires,the more likely people are to follow it.
